scripts.build: npm run build -w @maba-printing/shared && npm run build -w @maba-printing/api && npm run build -w @maba-printing/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @maba-printing/web" "npm run dev -w @maba-printing/api"
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['packages/shared/dist','apps/api/dist','apps/web/dist','apps/api/node_modules/.tmp','apps/web/node_modules/.tmp','apps/web/test-results','apps/web/playwright-report','coverage','apps/web/coverage','apps/api/coverage','packages/shared/coverage']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
